        String[] tokens = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(tokens[0]);
        double target = Double.parseDouble(tokens[1]);
        br.close();

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {

        System.out.println(minX);

    static int binomial(int N, int K) {
        if (K < 0 || K > N) return 0;
        if (K == 0 || K == N) return 1;
        if (K > N - K) K = N - K;
        long val = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            val = val * (N - K + i) / i;
        }
        return (int) val;
    }
